使一个友方随从获得+1/+1，然后获得等同于其攻击力的
护甲值。
record.text_en: Give a friendly minion +1/+1, then gain Armor equal to its Attack.

record.name: 活体法力
record.text: 将你所有的法力水晶变成2/2的树人，当它们死亡时恢复你的法力值。
record.text_en: Transform your Mana Crystals into 2/2 Treants. Recover the mana when they die.

record.name: 能量零食
record.text: 仅在下回合，获得两个法力水晶。
record.text_en: Gain 2 Mana Crystals next turn only.

record.name: 鼓舞
record.text: 抉择：获得一个空的法力水晶；或者抽一张牌。
record.text_en: Choose One - Gain an empty Mana Crystal; or Draw a card.

record.name: 蛮熊搬家
record.text: 获取两张3/3并具有嘲讽的熊，其每在你手牌中一回合便获得+1/+1。
record.text_en: [x]Get two 3/3 Bears with Taunt. Each turn they are in your hand, they gain +1/+1.

record.name: 安戈洛宣传单
record.text: 抽两张随从牌，使其获得+2/+2。 （每回合翻面。）
record.text_en: [x]Draw two minions. Give them +2/+2. (Flips each turn.)

record.name: 仙人掌构造术
record.text: 发现一张法力值消耗为（2）的随从牌，召唤一个它的1/2的复制。
record.text_en: Discover a 2-Cost minion. Summon a 1/2 copy of it.

record.name: 补水
record.text: 恢复#7点生命值。快枪：复原两个法力水晶。
record.text_en: Restore #7 Health. Quickdraw: Refresh 2 Mana Crystals.

record.text: 召唤两个2/2的树人。使你的随从获得+2/+1。
record.text_en: Summon two 2/2 Treants. Give your minions +2/+1.
